title: Hardware Control Register Decoding & Bit Manipulation
description:
Hardware registers combine enable flags, interrupt masks, and multi-bit configuration settings.

### Control Register Layout:
- Bit 0: `PE` (Peripheral Enable)
- Bit 1: `TXIE` (Transmit Interrupt Enable)
- Bit 2: `RXIE` (Receive Interrupt Enable)
- Bits [9:8]: `SPEED` (0=Low, 1=Medium, 2=High, 3=Very High)
- All other bits: 0
hint: Bit shifts and masks (`(field & mask) << shift`) avoid implementation-defined compiler struct bitfield layouts while remaining portable across ARM, RISC-V, and x86.
